_comment: Veo's feed emits exactly these 100 values for EVERY vehicle type: an integer
state-of-charge percent mapped through one vendor-side table. Captured from a
live GBFS snapshot 2026-07-06 and verified against the 37-day R2 archive
(2026-05-31..2026-07-06, 44.2M points: 100 distinct values globally AND every
single day, same min/max daily) by scripts/analyze_range_signal.py.
battery percent = round(100 * rank / 99) of a value's rank in this sorted list.
Values not in the list mean the vendor table drifted - compute_battery_percent
falls back to linear scaling and logs a warning; if that fires, re-derive this
